title: 上海高考翻译背诵-83-SSP高考专刊

items.zh: 这家公司的技术人员可以提供办公设备的现场安装服务。
items.en: The company’s technicians can provide on-site installation of office equipment.

items.zh: 在国外社交媒体平台上,去中国旅游的短视频浏览量和点赞数正在节节攀升。
items.en: On foreign social media platforms, views and likes of short videos about traveling to China are on the rise.

items.zh: 由于飞船故障而滞留国际空间站的两位美国宇航员真能如期于明年二月返回地球吗?
items.en: Due to the spacecraft malfunction, would the two astronauts stranded on the International Space Station return to Earth next February as scheduled?

items.zh: 我听说用无人机播种、施肥、喷洒农药(pesticides)成本低、速度快,而且效果特别好,已经让越来越多的农民享受到了科技进步带来的便利。
items.en: I have heard that sowing, fertilizing and spraying pesticides using drones is low-cost, fast and particularly effective, allowing an increasing number of farmers to take advantage of the benefits brought by advances in science and technology.
